returnSemantics: simple close-to-close return, percentage points; split-adjusted for pre-split 0050 prices; distribution-inclusive on 0050's official ex-dividend date only (cash-distribution-inclusive investor return, (P_t + D_t) / P_previous - 1)
executionAssumption: same-period-close decision + frictionless close execution. This is a validation assumption reused from the existing clecHistoricalBacktest.ts Foundation; it is not a real, tradable execution model.
missingDataPolicy: fail-closed; no interpolation, no forward-fill, no synthetic price. A date is only a valid common period if all three reference symbols have an official TWSE closing price for that date.
mappingSemantics: validation-only. This mapping is the UR-TODO-014 historical validation reference portfolio ONLY. It is NOT the CLEC canonical symbol mapping, NOT a Production default portfolio, NOT an AppState role mapping, NOT the user's current holdings mapping, and NOT the UR-TODO-058 (three-strategy comparison) contract.

split.evidence: TWSE STOCK_DAY_AVG for 0050 shows the last close of 188.65 on 2025-06-10, no rows for 2025-06-11 through 2025-06-17, and resumed trading at 47.57 on 2025-06-18 (188.65 / 4 = 47.1625, consistent with a 4:1 split reference basis; the small remaining gap to the actual 47.57 close reflects normal first-day post-split trading, not a data error).

distributionsAppliedInThisDataset.reason: Only in-window (2025-06-02 ~ 2025-08-29) official ex-dividend date for 0050.

0050.note: Full official distribution list (2024-01-17 through 2026-07-21) retrieved from TWSE ETF 分配收益 for stkNo=0050 (6 records total, 2010-01-01~2026-08-20 startDate/endDate query window; earliest record returned by TWSE for this query range was 2024-01-17). Only the 2025-07-21 record falls inside this dataset's validation window and is applied.

split.evidence: TWSE STOCK_DAY_AVG for 00631L shows the last close of 443.15 on 2026-03-24, no rows for 2026-03-25 through 2026-03-30, and resumed trading at an actual close of 19.26 on 2026-03-31. 443.15 / 22 = 20.1432 (rounds to 20.14), which is the officially reported post-split reference/base price for the resumption day; the 19.26 actual close is where trading settled that day within the reference-price-anchored limit-up/down band. Both values are officially sourced from TWSE; they are not in conflict — reference price and closing price are two distinct, both-legitimate TWSE fields.
split.usedForNormalization: This dataset's validation window (2025-06-02 ~ 2025-08-29) does not include 2026-03, so this split is NOT embedded in the main backtest periods. It is validated as a standalone split-normalization regression using this officially-sourced price pair, per the test list in tests/clecTwReferenceHistoricalValidation.test.ts.

00631L.note: TWSE ETF 分配收益 for stkNo=00631L returned zero rows across the full queried history (2010-01-01 ~ 2026-08-20). Preserved as a 'zero official distribution records' provenance fact, not an omission.
